extras: Works on desktop and mobile; available in English and German.
intentEvidence: Focus First automatically sorts your Obsidian tasks into an Eisenhower or Value/Effort matrix
problem: Users struggle to determine which tasks to work on next from a large list of to-dos.

relations.evidence: Works alongside the Tasks plugin - Focus First reads the same checkbox/due-date/priority syntax but doesn't require it

summary: Focus First automatically sorts Obsidian tasks into Eisenhower or Value/Effort matrices to help users prioritize their next actions.
